investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api because the Kubernetes scheduler could not place the agent pod: 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm resources and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. The pod remained unscheduled for 136–147 seconds, exceeding the eval timeout, and no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected because agent creation never reached a running state.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its schedulable kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity. Of the 6 available nodes, only 2 are eligible for kata peer-pod workloads and both report insufficient VM quota; the other 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity or selector constraints. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on the 2 eligible nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod creation attempt stalls indefinitely, the eval probe times out before the agent reaches a ready state, and all required evidence fields remain empty. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity failure scoped to the remote-agents Swarm/kata runtime in the production-api environment; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api because the Kubernetes scheduler could not place the agent pod: 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm resources and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. The pod remained unscheduled for 136–147 seconds, exceeding the eval timeout, and no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected because agent creation never reached a running state.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its schedulable kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity. Of the 6 available nodes, only 2 are eligible for kata peer-pod workloads and both report insufficient VM quota; the other 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity or selector constraints. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on the 2 eligible nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod creation attempt stalls indefinitely, the eval probe times out before the agent reaches a ready state, and all required evidence fields remain empty. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity failure scoped to the remote-agents Swarm/kata runtime in the production-api environment; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 3 Remote-Agent Checks
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes have no available kata.peerpods.io/vm slots (2 nodes report Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm; 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity/selector), causing every remote-agent pod to remain Unschedulable until the eval timeout. Because no agent pod could be scheduled, the eval runner never reached the point of creating an agent or invoking the runtime, so zero evidence fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) were collected and the expected-output contract was entirely unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource capacity on the two nodes that carry that resource label. The remaining four nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector requirements. With no schedulable node available and preemption unable to free capacity, every remote-agent pod is stuck Unschedulable. This is a cluster-level infrastructure resource exhaustion localized to the kata peer-pods VM resource pool, not an application code defect. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence; this is an eval-layer failure reflecting the state of the production-api Kubernetes cluster at the time of the run.
